Hi Anna, Markus, Laura,

Apologies for the delay — we completed the bookkeeping review this morning. Summary of actions taken:

1) Duplicate seat charge on BH-443: confirmed. We have issued a service credit in the amount of $12,400 USD (equals the duplicate 6-seat overcharge for August) and applied it to your October 2026 invoice. Credit note: CN-2026-09-172.

2) VAT on BH-444: we found the EU VAT exemption had not been properly linked to the billing entity due to a metadata mismatch. We have reclassified BH-444 and created an adjustment for VAT of $2,140 USD; this is recorded on the same credit note CN-2026-09-172 and offsets your October statement. If you need a cash refund instead, please reply and we’ll route to payments (note: refunds take 7-10 business days once issued).

3) SLA goodwill credit: after reviewing SLA-metrics-Aug2026.csv and cross-checking operational logs, we agree the incidents qualify for a single incident credit under our policy. We applied an additional $1,200 goodwill credit to CN-2026-09-172.

Total credit applied: $15,740 USD.

We have attached the credit note and updated invoices to a shared Drive folder and pushed a HubSpot note. DocuSign amendment is optional — the credit has been applied now and will appear on your Oct invoice regardless of signature. Links: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/amendment-BH-443, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-SLA-evidence

If everything looks correct, no action is required on your side. If you'd like a cash refund, please let us know and Laura will coordinate payment details.

Best regards,
